messages:
nina: Quick planning thread for the Oct webinar promo cadence. Need: timeline, A/B headline test, gated asset plan, and speaker fallback bullets.
marta: thanks. high-level: start promos 3 weeks out, paid push 10 days out, reminder drip 48h and 2h before. CTA always: register + "get benchmark CSV" for high intent.
jim: speaker fallbacks: if alex can't demo, leo steps in with a pre-record + short live Q&A. if both out, play recorded demo + host walkthrough. keep it scripted.
sophia: A/B headline test idea: A = "Cut inference cost without losing quality" B = "Reduce model spend: real benchmarks & quick wins". Run to 10% of registrants for 72h. track CTR -> reg rate.
marketing-bot: Suggestion: run Variant A on LinkedIn, Variant B on Twitter/X, measure landing CTR via utm_campaign param.
leo: For gated asset: full benchmark CSV + runbook + quant scripts (zip). Gating rule: company_size > 50 OR indicated 'evaluate cost' on reg form -> immediate access via salesforce tag.
marta: Good. Add a lightweight 'try this in 15 minutes' one-pager as open asset for all registrants (no gating) so everyone gets quick value.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: Webinar - Cost & Benchmarks (2024-10-09 17:00 UTC). Green room link in event notes.
nina: Promo copy drafts: short tweet, LinkedIn opener, and 2-line email. I'll post drafts by EOD. Need 2 talking bullets per speaker.
jim: Speaker bullets:
- jim (host): "why predictable serving matters" + "where to push for cost wins"
- marta: "benchmark headline" + "one config to try (batching)"
- alex/leo (demo): "demo setup" + "fallback story"
sophia: Rehearsal schedule: tech check 48h prior (15m), full run 24h prior (30m), dress 2h prior (45m). Also 10-min sync 60m before show.
leo: Green room checklist I'll own: mics, co-hosts, screenshare permissions, backup clip on CDN, host fallback scripts. I'll post a short doc with checkboxes.
marta: Promotion timeline (high level): week -3: announce + organic posts; -10d: paid; -7d: partner outreach; -3d: reminder; -48h: tech check; -24h: run-through; -2h: dress; D: hour-of sync + live.
nina: Landing page form tweaks: add hidden field "intent_level" (options: explore, evaluate, buy). We'll use that for lead scoring. Also add a short question: "Which cost levers are you most interested in?" with multi-select.
jim: Lead routing: high intent -> SDR alert + auto-email with gated CSV. medium -> nurture sequence. low -> drip 2-week follow-up. Tag in SFDC: "Webinar-Oct-GLB".
marketing-bot: Recommend gating via one-click OAuth to reduce friction. Also include a download link in the post-webinar replay email.
sophia: QA prep: I'll draft 10 anticipated Qs and short 30-45s answers. We'll pick 5 to read live. Also create a shared doc for audience questions with contributor column.
leo: Demo fallback script (host one-liner) suggestion: "We're switching to a pre-recorded clip for a moment to keep the flow smooth; we'll bring the live view back as soon as possible." short, calm.
marta: Good. Also: prepare two short slide variations for the benchmark graph (detailed vs executive) so host can swap if audience skews technical or exec.
nina: Action items:
- nina: post promo drafts by EOD (tweet, LI, 30s script)
- leo: green room checklist + upload clip CDN link by 24h before run-through
- sophia: QA doc + answers by 24h before run-through
- marta: finalize gated asset bundle and share gating rules with nina
- jim: confirm host notes + one-liners by run-through
- marketing-bot: set up A/B headline test and tracking UTMs
ops-bot: Calendar updated with rehearsal times and reminders.
jim: After each rehearsal please post a 3-bullet postmortem in this thread: wins, one fix, and slide edits. We'll use that to lock landing copy and email follow-ups.
marta: One last ask: keep all promo creative in the shared folder: https://drive.company/marketing/webinars/cost-benchmarks. Nina, drop promo assets there.
nina: will do. thanks everyone. I'll post the drafts in an hour. :sparkles:
